content.comment_body: I'm experiencing a similar issue with this device: [article_no]. I purchased a used controller second hand, connected it to power, and now want to edit the program. However, it's protected by a password I do not have. How can I reset the device to clear the old password and program? Otherwise, it will be unusable. I did not receive a data cable.
Welcome to the forum. If you enter the wrong password three times consecutively, you can delete the program.
Please check the attached [document], which contains a full list for each version.
This [document] was already linked in this topic by [user_name].

@[user_name], depending on your geographic location (or VPN settings), that link might not always be accessible. For example, when I am near South Korea, the link appears broken, but using a VPN (Netherlands) lets me view the page. I keep this [document] in my main folder and have downloaded it from this forum before; it's very useful when working with multiple versions. That's why I uploaded the [document]—especially since I work with controllers from various manufacturers and developers, and often need to clear passwords to upload new configurations.
Thank you very much. Issue resolved—the password was successfully cleared.

analysis.insight_summary: A user encountered difficulties accessing and configuring a second-hand [product_name] due to an unknown password. Forum members provided practical solutions to clear the password and program, making the device reusable. Sharing helpful documentation and expert advice enabled a successful resolution and demonstrated the importance of having accessible resources when handling multiple versions.
analysis.user_expectations: The user aims to completely reset the [product_name], removing password protection and the existing program, so it can be set up from scratch without previous restrictions.
